Claude checked 2026-10-23:
[Anthropic pricing](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing),

[^codex]: Standard-speed credit rates; no cache-write charge. API-key usage follows API pricing. Fast: 2× credits; included usage is 2× for GPT-6.2, 2.5× for older models. GPT-6.2 Ultrafast: 6× included usage; purchased credits/PAYG 3× through 2027-02-28, then 6× from 2027-03-01 (Pacific time).
[^claude]: Anthropic API rates; Pro/Max/Team plans draw from plan usage limits instead. Cache writes: 1.25× input (5m), 2× input (1h). Haiku 5.5 prompts >100K tokens: 5× all rates. `opusplan`: Opus in plan mode, Sonnet for execution.
